README.md
files.body:
# SignalBoard

An on-chain trading signal board on **Gno.land Onyx testnet** (chain `onyx-1`),
built for the Gnome Tavern hackathon.

Anyone can post a structured trading signal (asset, direction, reference
price, short rationale). The author later resolves their own signal as won or
lost. The realm keeps a **public, verifiable per-author track record**
(posted / won / lost / win rate) and renders the board on gnoweb — no separate
frontend, no off-chain database: the performance record lives on-chain and
anyone can audit it.

## Deployment status

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Realm path | `gno.land/r/g18hk5n6qmgtxqlljy5athr3u3xg669sqayrfv5z/signalboard` |
| Deployer address | `g18hk5n6qmgtxqlljy5athr3u3xg669sqayrfv5z` |
| gnoweb (once live) | https://onyx.testnets.gno.land/r/g18hk5n6qmgtxqlljy5athr3u3xg669sqayrfv5z/signalboard |
| Status | **PENDING FUNDING** — see below |
| addpkg tx hash | _(pending)_ |
| Example signal tx hashes | _(pending)_ |
| gpao approval | _(not yet submitted)_ |

**Why pending:** the Onyx faucet (https://faucet.onyx.testnets.gno.land)
requires an hCaptcha token minted in a real browser session (JSON-RPC `drip`
with `meta.captcha`); it cannot be claimed from a headless shell. The deployer
account exists and everything else is built, tested and scripted. The moment
the address is funded, deployment is a single command:

```bash
./deploy.sh                          # deploys + waits for gpao activation
python3 bridge/post_signals.py --live  # posts 3 example signals from
                                       # live public prices
```

`deploy.sh` polls the render query until the realm answers, because new
packages on Onyx pass the **gpao (package approvals oracle)** queue before
they become callable; if approval stalls, check the rejection reason on the
gpas testnet explorer.

## Architecture

```
                 gnokey maketx call                 gnoweb / vm/qrender
  Python bridge ───────────────►  SignalBoard realm ───────────────► board
  (bridge/post_signals.py)        (signalboard.gno)                  (public)
        │                               │
        │ live prices                   │ PostSignal / ResolveSignal
        ▼                               │ per-author stats + events
  data-api.binance.vision               ▼
  (public, no key)                 Onyx testnet (onyx-1)
```

- **`signalboard.gno`** — the realm. State: a slice of `Signal` structs and a
  per-author `AuthorStats` map. Written for the current Gno realm API
  (`cur realm` crossing functions, caller identity from `cur.Previous()`,
  direct-user-call guard via `IsUserCall()`). Free-text fields are sanitized
  on write so user input cannot break out of the markdown board rendering.
  Emits `SignalPosted` / `SignalResolved` events.
- **`signalboard_test.gno`** — 5 tests (post, validation + sanitization,
  resolve-as-won incl. non-author/double-resolve rejection, resolve-as-lost,
  rendering). All pass: `gno test .` → `ok`.
- **`bridge/post_signals.py`** — small Python bridge (stdlib only). Reads a
  JSON list of signals — or builds three from live public prices with
  `--live` (naive 24h-momentum direction) — and posts each via
  `gnokey maketx call`, recording tx hashes in `bridge/last_run.json`.
- **`deploy.sh`** — balance check → `gnokey maketx addpkg` → poll render
  until the realm is live through the gpao queue.

### Realm API

| Function | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PostSignal(cur realm, asset, direction, refPrice, note string) uint64` | tx | Post a signal; direction `long`/`short`; returns the signal ID. Emits `SignalPosted`. |
| `ResolveSignal(cur realm, id uint64, won bool)` | tx | Author-only resolution of an open signal. Emits `SignalResolved`. |
| `TotalSignals() int` / `OpenSignals() int` | query | Board counters. |
| `Render(path string) string` | query | `""` = board + leaderboard; `"signal/<id>"` = one signal. |

## Run the tests locally

Toolchain: official Gno **v1.8.0** binaries (`gno`, `gnokey`, `gnodev` from
the gnolang/gno GitHub release, checksums verified). The standalone `gno`
binary needs the matching source tree for its stdlibs:

```bash
export GNOROOT=/path/to/gno-v1.8.0-source
cd app/
gno test .        # 5/5 pass
gno lint .
```

## Network notes (this VM)

`gnokey`'s Go RPC client ignores HTTP(S)_PROXY and dials directly; on
machines whose direct egress is intercepted, all chain traffic must go
through a local forwarder that tunnels via the egress proxy:

```bash
python3 ../rpc_forwarder.py 26657 rpc.onyx.testnets.gno.land &
# then use -remote http://127.0.0.1:26657 (the default in deploy.sh/bridge)
```

On an unrestricted network, skip the forwarder and use
`GNO_REMOTE=https://rpc.onyx.testnets.gno.land:443`.

## Keys

The deployer key (`gnokey` name `signalboard`) and its mnemonic backup live
outside this repository in `~/.keys-gno/` (dir 700, files 600). The mnemonic
is never printed, logged, or committed. The key password is in
`~/.keys-gno/keypass.txt` and is fed to gnokey via
`-insecure-password-stdin` by the scripts.

## Test evidence

```
$ gno test -v .
=== RUN   TestPostSignal            --- PASS
=== RUN   TestPostSignalValidation  --- PASS
=== RUN   TestResolveSignal         --- PASS
=== RUN   TestResolveLost           --- PASS
=== RUN   TestRender                --- PASS
ok      .   ~2s
```

Bridge dry-run and live-price signal generation verified; a real
`PostSignal` call was attempted and correctly fails at simulation today
only because the package is not deployed yet and the account is unfunded —
the full path (bridge → gnokey → forwarder → Onyx RPC) responds end to end.

files.body:
package oathledger

import (
	"chain"
	"chain/banker"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"gno.land/p/nt/avl/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/testutils/v0"
	"gno.land/p/nt/uassert/v0"
)

const realmPath = "gno.land/r/g1ty0rp975ndkcse760v0zt659f4phs4z8lueud7/oathledger"

func resetState() {
	pacts = *avl.NewTree()
	builders = *avl.NewTree()
	nextPactID = 1
	totalEscrowedUgnot = 0
	activeLockedUgnot = 0
	totalReleasedUgnot = 0
	completedPactsCount = 0
	disputedPactsCount = 0
}

func TestFullMultiMilestoneQuorumLifecycle(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetState()

	pkgAddr := chain.PackageAddress(realmPath)
	sponsor := testutils.TestAddress("sponsor1")
	builder := testutils.TestAddress("builder1")
	rev1 := testutils.TestAddress("reviewer1")
	rev2 := testutils.TestAddress("reviewer2")
	rev3 := testutils.TestAddress("reviewer3")
	outsider := testutils.TestAddress("outsider1")

	escrowAmt := int64(10_000_000) // 10 GNOT
	testing.IssueCoins(pkgAddr, chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: escrowAmt}})

	// 1. Sponsor creates a 2-milestone pact (40% / 60%) with 2-of-3 quorum
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: escrowAmt}})
	reviewersCSV := rev1.String() + "," + rev2.String() + "," + rev3.String()
	id := CreatePact(
		cross(cur),
		"Zero-Knowledge Merkle Package",
		"Build and audit a pure Gno Merkle proof verifier.",
		"Spec & Math,Realm & Audit",
		"4000,6000",
		reviewersCSV,
		2,
		72,
	)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1), id)
	uassert.Equal(t, escrowAmt, activeLockedUgnot)

	// Sponsor cannot self-claim to farm PoC XP
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "sponsor cannot claim own pact", func() {
		ClaimPact(cross(cur), id)
	})

	// 2. Builder claims pact and submits Milestone 0
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(builder))
	ClaimPact(cross(cur), id)
	SubmitMilestone(cross(cur), id, 0, "https://github.com/org/repo/commit/abc123")

	// Outsider cannot approve
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(outsider))
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "caller is not a designated reviewer", func() {
		ApproveMilestone(cross(cur), id, 0)
	})

	// 3. Reviewer 1 votes (1/2 quorum -> no payout yet)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(rev1))
	ApproveMilestone(cross(cur), id, 0)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), totalReleasedUgnot)

	// Duplicate vote rejected
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "reviewer already approved this milestone", func() {
		ApproveMilestone(cross(cur), id, 0)
	})

	// 4. Reviewer 2 casts deciding vote (2/2 quorum -> 4 GNOT atomically released!)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(rev2))
	ApproveMilestone(cross(cur), id, 0)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(4_000_000), totalReleasedUgnot)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(6_000_000), activeLockedUgnot)

	roBanker := banker.NewReadonlyBanker()
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(4_000_000), roBanker.GetCoin(builder, "ugnot"))

	// 5. Complete Milestone 1 (6 GNOT) -> pact transitions to COMPLETED
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(builder))
	SubmitMilestone(cross(cur), id, 1, "https://github.com/org/repo/commit/def456")
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(rev1))
	ApproveMilestone(cross(cur), id, 1)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(rev3))
	ApproveMilestone(cross(cur), id, 1)

	uassert.Equal(t, int64(10_000_000), totalReleasedUgnot)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), activeLockedUgnot)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(1), completedPactsCount)
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(10_000_000), roBanker.GetCoin(builder, "ugnot"))
	uassert.True(t, GetBuilderXP(builder) >= 400, "xp")

	// Verify multi-route Render output
	home := Render("")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "OathLedger"), "home title")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(home, "COMPLETED"), "home completed")
	detail := Render("pact/1")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "Merkle Package"), "detail title")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(detail, "10.000000 GNOT"), "detail amount")
	lb := Render("leaderboard")
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(lb, builder.String()), "lb builder")
	prof := Render("builder/" + builder.String())
	uassert.True(t, strings.Contains(prof, "10.000000 GNOT"), "prof amount")
}

func TestTrustlessQuorumDisputeResolution(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetState()

	pkgAddr := chain.PackageAddress(realmPath)
	sponsor := testutils.TestAddress("sponsor_d")
	builder := testutils.TestAddress("builder_d")
	rev1 := testutils.TestAddress("rev_d1")
	rev2 := testutils.TestAddress("rev_d2")

	escrowAmt := int64(5_000_000)
	testing.IssueCoins(pkgAddr, chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: escrowAmt}})

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: escrowAmt}})
	id := CreatePact(cross(cur), "Disputed Task", "Test quorum arbitration.", "Full Delivery", "10000", rev1.String()+","+rev2.String(), 2, 48)

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(builder))
	ClaimPact(cross(cur), id)
	RaiseDispute(cross(cur), id, "Scope changed mid-sprint")

	// Reviewers agree on 60% builder / 40% sponsor split
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(rev1))
	VoteDisputeResolution(cross(cur), id, 6000)
	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(rev2))
	VoteDisputeResolution(cross(cur), id, 6000)

	roBanker := banker.NewReadonlyBanker()
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(3_000_000), roBanker.GetCoin(builder, "ugnot"))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(2_000_000), roBanker.GetCoin(sponsor, "ugnot"))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), activeLockedUgnot)
}

func TestDeadlineExpiryReclaim(cur realm, t *testing.T) {
	defer resetState()

	pkgAddr := chain.PackageAddress(realmPath)
	sponsor := testutils.TestAddress("sponsor_e")
	rev1 := testutils.TestAddress("rev_e1")

	escrowAmt := int64(2_000_000)
	testing.IssueCoins(pkgAddr, chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: escrowAmt}})

	testing.SetRealm(testing.NewUserRealm(sponsor))
	testing.SetOriginSend(chain.Coins{{Denom: "ugnot", Amount: escrowAmt}})
	id := CreatePact(cross(cur), "Expired Bounty", "Testing safe timeout refund.", "Deliverable", "10000", rev1.String(), 1, 2)

	// Cannot reclaim before deadline
	uassert.AbortsWithMessage(t, cur, "pact deadline has not passed yet", func() {
		ReclaimExpired(cross(cur), id)
	})

	// Simulate deadline passing and reclaim cleanly
	pact := mustGetPact(id)
	pact.Deadline = time.Now().Add(-1 * time.Minute)
	ReclaimExpired(cross(cur), id)

	roBanker := banker.NewReadonlyBanker()
	uassert.Equal(t, escrowAmt, roBanker.GetCoin(sponsor, "ugnot"))
	uassert.Equal(t, int64(0), activeLockedUgnot)
}

files.name: README.md
files.body:
# TavernTab — a tavern tab (escrow) realm on Gno.land

At the Gnome Tavern you don't pay per drink — you **open a tab**. The realm
holds your GNOT, and the tab is later **settled** (the payee gets paid) or
**cancelled** (you get refunded in full). Only the payer can settle or cancel
their own tab, and only once. Everything is on the record: the realm's
`Render` board shows every tab and how much the tavern is holding, readable
in a browser on gnoweb with no wallet.

Built for the Gnome Tavern Hackathon (DoraHacks). Entrant: Indra Dwi Junianto.

## Realm

Path: `gno.land/r/ghea12/taverntab` (namespace to be confirmed/claimed at
testnet deploy time)

| Function | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `OpenTab(payee, memo)` | Payable. Send ugnot with the call; the realm records tab {id, payer, payee, amount, memo, status=open} and returns the id. Direct user calls only. |
| `SettleTab(id)` | Payer only, tab open: the realm sends the held amount to the payee; status=settled. |
| `CancelTab(id)` | Payer only, tab open: full refund to the payer; status=cancelled. |
| `GetTab(id)` | Read-only snapshot of one tab. |
| `HeldTotal()` | ugnot currently held across all open tabs. |
| `Render("")` / `Render("<id>")` | The public board / a single tab, rendered by gnoweb. |

## Develop

Toolchain: official precompiled binaries in `~/.gno/bin` (v1.8.0). The
binaries need the matching source tree for stdlibs/examples:

```sh
export PATH="$HOME/.gno/bin:$PATH"
export GNOROOT="$HOME/.gno/src/gno-1.8.0"   # v1.8.0 source tarball, files only (nothing built from it)

gno test .        # unit tests
gno lint .
gnodev local .    # local devnet: realm auto-deploys, gnoweb on http://127.0.0.1:8888
```

Local dependency note: the realm imports three small public packages
(`gno.land/p/nt/ufmt/v0`, `gno.land/p/nt/markdown/sanitize/v0`, and the test
helpers `testutils`/`uassert`). On this machine the toolchain's on-chain
package download is blocked by the sandbox proxy, so the workspace root
(`~/workspace/hackathons/gnome/`) carries a `gnowork.toml` plus pristine
copies of those packages (and their one transitive dep, `p/onbloc/diff/v0`)
under `gno.land/p/...`, which the tooling resolves locally. On an
unrestricted machine the same imports resolve from the chain and the copies
are unnecessary.

## Status

Phase 1 (local) complete: tests green, both escrow cycles proven on a local
`gnodev` devnet. See `../EVIDENCE.md`. Testnet (Onyx) deployment is phase 2.
